editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a guy used to running a prison is suddenly put in charge of a wild public school? You get a hilarious mess of a movie where Leonid, a strict former colony deputy, tries to clean up one of the craziest schools in town. The vibe is fast and chaotic, feeling like a giant battle between a man who loves rules and students who live to break them. You will love watching Leonid try to use his old prison tricks on teenagers who are way more cunning than he expected, making for some really funny awkward moments.

The acting is spot on, especially seeing the lead actor switch from being a tough guy to looking completely defeated. While the plot is simple, the pacing keeps you laughing without feeling too slow. Some jokes might feel a bit over the top, but that just adds to the charm. If you are looking for a lighthearted comedy, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After months of fighting with the students and staff, Leonid finally stops trying to treat the school like a prison. He learns that kindness and understanding work better than strict rules. In the final scenes, he earns the actual respect of the kids and the teachers. He succeeds in his mission, proves he can handle the chaos, and finds a new way to lead people without using fear, wrapping things up on a heartwarming note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fish-out-of-water comedies and school humor.
